7999.title: Empty environment selection uses ambiguous labels
7999.rootCauseOneLine: The unselected picker falls back to Environment/Env instead of prompting for an environment; compact CSS exposes the abbreviated noun beside a laptop icon.
7999.proposedFix: Use Choose environment for both empty-selection display variants and retain all selection policy.
7999.caveats: Exact component state verified twice, with real browser captures; full macOS desktop/Connect creation sequence not exercised.
